question: For which stored rulesets is the evaluator promotion zone disjoint from every compilation-legal promotion source square?
why_it_changes_a_decision: It decides whether the pooled in-zone contact ratio can be read as a uniform geometric effect: seeds whose zone contains no promotion source can never contribute to the in-zone column, so the pooled ratio is a composition average over two rule regimes. Without this partition the ratio reads as a property of the term.
no_new_search: ruleset regeneration only; no search, no game replay, no frozen fitness

design.seeds: every seed present in the stored Stage 8 per-game records
design.zone: evaluator._zones[(base_type_id, side)] for base types with positive promotion gain
design.per_seed_output: zone square count, promotion source count, intersection count, disjointness flag

excluded_on_purpose.contact_count: not recorded; a zero for disjoint seeds is definitional because movegen only builds a promotion variant when (from,to) is in compiled.promotion_allowed
excluded_on_purpose.rate_contrast: the earlier 0-vs-53 in-zone rate contrast is withdrawn and must not be reproduced here

endpoint_written_before_the_run: decision zone_disjointness_partition_recorded if every seed in the corpus is classified and the artifact carries no contact count or rate field; otherwise decision blocked_with_reason plus the failing seeds
done_condition: results_zone_promotion_disjointness.json regenerated from scratch by the committed scan script, a verifier reproduces it, and the public evidence copy rebuilds byte-identically
